fortunes.text: Past: You survived everything that tried to stop you. Now: You're here. That's the whole point. Ahead: This year, you stop explaining yourself.
Past: You spent the last year learning which doors were locked. Now: You're standing in a room you built yourself. Ahead: Do not ask permission to change the furniture.
Past: Your twenties have been about finding the right masks. Now: You're ready to take them off. Ahead: The people who matter already know your face.
Past: You've been apologizing for taking up space. Now: The room is getting smaller. Ahead: Take more.
Past: You spent your twenties learning which doors were locked. Now: You're standing in a room you built yourself. Ahead: Do not ask permission to change the furniture.
Past: You've outgrown the version of yourself that needed everyone's approval. Now: You're becoming the version that needs no one's permission. Ahead: Use it wisely.
Past: You've spent decades collecting other people's expectations. Now: You're ready to put them down. Ahead: The best part starts now.
Past: You've learned that the hard way is the only way that sticks. Now: You're teaching others without trying. Ahead: Keep going.
Past: You've earned every silver hair. Now: You're finally becoming yourself. Ahead: The world needs what you have.
Past: You've survived things that would have broken someone else. Now: You're still standing. Ahead: Keep standing.
Past: You've accumulated more wisdom than most people will ever know. Now: You're the elder someone needs. Ahead: Share it.
Past: You've outlived the things that scared you. Now: You're the scariest thing in the room. Ahead: Use it kindly.
Past: You've been waiting for permission to change. Now: The permission was never coming. Ahead: Change anyway.
Past: You've been preparing for the wrong thing. Now: The real test looks nothing like this. Ahead: Trust your instincts.
Past: You've been waiting to feel ready. Now: Ready is a myth. Ahead: Act anyway.
Past: You've been comparing your chapter one to someone else's chapter twenty. Now: You're writing your own story. Ahead: It's a good one.
Past: You've been carrying other people's baggage. Now: It's time to set it down. Ahead: Travel light.
Past: You've been told to slow down. Now: Your pace is your own. Ahead: Keep moving.
Past: You've been haunted by a decision you made years ago. Now: It's time to forgive yourself. Ahead: The haunting stops today.
Past: You've been waiting for the right moment. Now: The right moment was always now. Ahead: Seize it.
Past: You've been running from something that's actually running toward you. Now: Stop. Ahead: It's not what you think.
Past: You've been living someone else's dream. Now: It's time to wake up. Ahead: Your dream is waiting.
Past: You've been afraid of failing. Now: Failure is the only teacher that matters. Ahead: Fail forward.
Past: You've been building a life that looks good on paper. Now: It's time to build one that feels good in your chest. Ahead: Start today.
Past: You've been waiting for the right time to start over. Now: The right time was decades ago. Ahead: Start anyway.
Past: You've been carrying a secret that's been eating you alive. Now: It's time to set it free. Ahead: The relief will be worth it.
Past: You've been waiting for someone to see you. Now: You've been hiding. Ahead: Step into the light.
Past: You've survived everything that tried to stop you. Now: You're here, and you're stronger than you know. Ahead: This is the year everything changes. Don't fight it.
Past: You've been waiting for a sign. Now: This is it. Ahead: Say yes before you're ready.
Past: You've been haunted by the person you used to be. Now: They're gone. Ahead: The person you're becoming is worth the wait.
